items.name: The Fractured Moon
items.description: A curved lattice divided by deliberate gaps. Its maker believed a conclusion should leave room to turn. The crescent returns by another path, and the airborne cut finishes a different sentence.

items.name: Event Horizon
items.description: A long, narrow spear with a suspended ring around its point. A courier marked each uninterrupted journey along its haft. The inscriptions celebrate arrival, never the distance another mind was pushed aside.

items.name: The Last Argument
items.description: Two unequal edges passed between companions who could agree on almost nothing. One cut opens a question; the other answers from an unexpected angle. Neither blade carries the word final.
